text: Yeah, but this is all customizable. I don't think anybody needs less than 10 sets a week per muscle, but yeah, that sounds about right. More than 30 sets per week of a muscle group should probably be for a very advanced person. Maybe we can add a pro level where some muscles can grow out of that if the person is really adamant about growing that muscle, but I don't think they're going to need around more than that. We still have the availability to add it on, but not necessarily a need. I think most people train around that: 20 to 30 sets per muscle per week. I believe so, but you can do some research and figure it out.
